title: Saddle Point
body_html:
Saddle Point

A pair of mixed strategies $(x^*,y^*)$ is a saddle point of a matrix game $A$ if for all $x \in \Delta(I)$ and $y \in \Delta(J)$, $$ x A y^* \le x^* A y^* \le x^* A y. $$

References

  • [MFoGT, Prop. 2.4.1(d)] Laraki, Renault, and Sorin, Mathematical Foundations of Game Theory, references/MechDesign.pdf. Saddle point inequality for matrix games.
